refused_program.intent: Catch up with upstream without losing additions or reviving removals by taking upstream's dependency file and re-adding local dependency additions.

postconditions.description: the upstream branch is an ancestor and no merge is still in progress
postconditions.name: merge_committed
postconditions.probe:
! git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD &&
git merge-base --is-ancestor {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} HEAD

postconditions.description: the index has no unmerged entries
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_entries

postconditions.description: the working tree is clean after the merge
postconditions.name: worktree_clean

postconditions.description: no conflict markers remain in tracked files
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers

preconditions.description: the working tree is clean and no merge or rebase is in progress
preconditions.name: clean_worktree
preconditions.probe:
! git status --porcelain -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -q . &&
! git ls-files -u -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -q . &&
[ ! -e .git/MERGE_HEAD ] &&
[ ! -e .git/rebase-merge ] &&
[ ! -e .git/rebase-apply ]

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch exists locally
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_exists

preconditions.description: both local and upstream have commits the other lacks
preconditions.name: branches_diverged

preconditions.description: a file changed on both sides cannot be merged cleanly
preconditions.name: common_changed_file_conflicts
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
  git merge-file -p \
    <(git show "HEAD:$path" 2>/dev/null || true) \
    <(git show "$base:$path" 2>/dev/null || true) \
    <(git show "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$path" 2>/dev/null || true) \
    >/dev/null 2>&1
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; then
    exit 0
  fi
  if [ "$status" -gt 1 ]; then
    exit 1
  fi
done < <(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  | tr '\n' '\0')
exit 1
